text:
lina: Quick planning thread for the upcoming multi-wave pentest. Two important items: coordinated access windows across regions, and a clear redaction policy so we don't leak customer PII in evidence.

otto: For regional windows: plan to open APAC window 08:00Z, EU 09:30Z, NA 14:00Z on day 1. Staggering helps avoid peak traffic collisions.

priya: Redaction policy idea: all personal identifiers must be redacted at export time unless the assessor has signed a special NDA addendum. Default exporter will mask email/ip but keep hashes for correlation.

harry: Agree on masking. Implementation detail: exporter will replace IPs with H(<ip>) and emails with H(<email>) and include a redact-map only accessible via decrypt-proxy to disclosed assessors. Decrypt-proxy logs any redact-map access to immutable-audit.

lina: Good. Also we need to decide on the manifest fields for multi-region: manifest must include region, az_list, service_tags, start_iso, end_iso, exporter_sha, associated_ticket, manifest_id. Keep CSV flat.

otto: RBAC model: create role `pt-assessor-<region>` and scope it down to service tags. We'll provision tokens per-region. Tokens auto-expire after 3h. Cross-region access requires a separate approval.

priya: Cross-region approval flow: post in #eng-security with justification + list of resources, infra-oncall and eng-security must approve. All approvals appended to manifest under `approvals`.

harry: KMS handling: continue envelope encryption. Important addition: for redaction maps we store them encrypted with a specific redact-CMK. Only decrypt-proxy can use it; decrypt-proxy never returns maps unless assessor has NDA tag. Access attempts are recorded with approver ids.

lina: SIEM ingestion: we need a mapping table so assessors' export filenames line up with our SIEM fields. Suggested provenance headers: iso_ts, service, host, instance_id, event_id, seq_no, sha256. Put mapping sample in docs.

otto: Also add a small test harness: teams must include a mini ingest manifest that shows how to map 3 example lines into Splunk/Elastic fields for the assessor. That will speed triage.

priya: Remediation tracking: recommend `pt-triage` board with columns: reported, acknowledged (24h SLO for critical), in-progress, ready-for-retest, verified. Each card must include manifest_id and remediation PR link.

harry: SLO detail: critical vulnerabilities require ack within 4h and remediation plan in 48h. High: ack 24h, plan 5 business days. We'll include SLOs in ticket template.

lina: Audit logging: every RBAC grant/revoke + decrypt-proxy token mint + redact-map access must be stored in immutable-audit stream with fields: event_ts, actor, action, resource, before_roles, after_roles, approval_ids. Retention: audit 18 months.

otto: For retests: automatic scheduling rules: when a ticket is labeled `ready-for-retest` enqueue to scheduler; first slot +7 days, second +21. If the fix is for critical vuln, allow expedited slot at +3 days but requires infra-oncall approval.

priya: Evidence shape: ndjson gz inside tar.gz, manifest.csv (flat), SHA256SUMS, detached .sig, export-command.txt (single line with exporter sha). Provide the exporter binary SHA in Exporter-SHA header.

harry: Provide example export command in docs:
```bash
./pt-export --region eu --from 2026-09-12T09:30:00Z --to 2026-09-12T10:30:00Z \
  --mask-pii --exporter-sha=abc1234 --out /tmp/pt-eu-1830009999.tar.gz
sha256sum /tmp/pt-eu-1830009999.tar.gz > /tmp/SHA256SUMS
redwood-sign --key redwood-signing /tmp/pt-eu-1830009999.tar.gz > /tmp/pt-eu-1830009999.sig
aws s3 cp /tmp/pt-eu-1830009999.tar.gz s3://redwood-pt/manifest_1830009999/ \
  --acl bucket-owner-full-control
```

lina: One nuance: when teams redact by default we still need a way for PS/legal to request full unredacted logs for internal forensic use. That flow must go through a strict approval and be recorded. We'll add a `forensics_request` flow in the runbook.

otto: Forensics flow: request in #eng-security with legal signoff + security director, infra-oncall must run decrypt-proxy with privileged flag. Action and approvers appended to manifest and immutable-audit. Only then is redact-map disclosed.

priya: Automation: ticket automation should enforce these checks: manifest present, SHA validated, exporter-sha present, repro sample included for retest, and ephemeral role removed post-fix. If any missing, bot comments checklist.

harry: Add test data requirement: retest ticket must include a minimal before/after snippet (redacted) and a small repro script. That reduces noise for assessors.

pt-ops-bot: Reminder: engagement "tundra" scheduled 2026-09-12T09:30:00Z. Provision pt-assessor roles 20m prior.

lina: Action items: Otto - add region-scoped role automation + approval flow; Priya - update exporter to support mask-pii and exporter-sha header; Harry - add redact-CMK handling in decrypt-proxy and immutable-audit hooks; I'll update the runbook and the triage board columns.

otto: Will prototype role automation by EOD Mon.

priya: Exporter change ready for PR tomorrow.

harry: Decrypt-proxy changes start next sprint.

lina: Dry-run scheduled Fri 2026-09-05 16:00 UTC. Keep dry-run logs concise. :sparkles:
